sentences.text:
3. Heard; Sri. Ajeesh M Ummer, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Smt. Neema T.
V., the learned Public Prosecutor.

4. After bestowing my anxious consideration to the facts, the rival submissions made across the Bar,
and the materials placed on record, particularly considering the fact that the first petitioner and the de-facto complainant were married as early as on 26.05.2013 and that there are matrimonial disputes pending between the parties and they have an estranged relationship, I hold that the petitioners' custodial interrogation is not necessary.

Hence, I am inclined to pass an interim order,
but subject to the condition that the petitioners co-operate with the Investigating Officer.
5.
In the result, the petitioners are directed to surrender before the Investigating Officer within one week from today, for subjecting themselves to interrogation.
The Investigating Officer would be at liberty to interrogate the petitioners for a period of two days, between 10 a.m and 5 p.m, within one week from the date of surrender.

If during the course of interrogation, the Investigating Officer arrests the petitioners, he shall release the petitioners on bail on them executing a bond for Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each with two solvent sureties each for the like sum, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer.
This order shall remain in force for a period of three weeks.
